verdict.rationale: Baseten's docs say you can deploy open-source, fine-tuned, or custom models on dedicated GPUs. Truss packages model code, weights, and dependencies and ships them with `truss push` or `baseten model push`, and training checkpoints deploy as production endpoints with one CLI command. Missing for 10: explicit LoRA adapter upload/serving (e.g. multi-LoRA on a shared base model), and independent hands-on corroboration of uploading custom weights.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can upload and serve my own custom model weights or LoRA adapters

citations.quote: Deploy an open-source, fine-tuned, or custom model on dedicated GPUs.
Package model code, weights, and dependencies with a model server that behaves the same in development and production.
describe the model in a `config.yaml` (for supported architectures) or a small Python `Model` class (for custom code), then run `baseten model push` to ship it
Deploy any synced checkpoint with one CLI command
